items.name: Shijiazhuang Open 2018

venue.name: Shijiazhuang Youth Social Comprehensive Practice School
venue.address: 100 meters north of Cuiping East Road, Chang 'an District

items.information:
The registration period is divided in two phases. The first phase starts at 20:00 on May 9th and ends at 23:59 on May 22th, while the second phase starts at 00:00 on May 23th and ends at 20:00 on May 30th. The registration fee includes basic entry fee and additional fee per event. The 2nd-phased registrant needs to pay the fee 0.5 time more than the early bird in the 1st phase of registration.

The limitation is 160 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule. For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee via Alipay on Cubingchina. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online and your registration is not accepted antomatically, pls contact the delegate via E-mail. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. Please check out the competition website for registration and the other information.

If you would like to cancel your registration, pls go through the registration page to do it by yourself and you will get 50% refund of the registration fee. Please keep in mind that, once you cancel the registraton, you are not able to attend the competition any more. The ending of the registration cancellation is at 00:00 on May 29th.
